title: The State of Independent Accountant Websites 2026
note: Aggregates computed from automated scans. No individual site is identified.
attribution: Free to use and cite under CC BY 4.0. Credit Clikiti with a link.
citation: Clikiti. (2026, October 15). The state of independent accountant websites 2026 (Q4 2026) [Report]. https://clikiti.com/research/accountants/2026-q4
audience: Web agencies and freelancers selling to small CPA firms, bookkeepers and tax preparers
findings: Only 13% of the 158 independent accounting, bookkeeping and tax practice websites we scanned show any price, package or fee.
A typical site answers three of the nine questions clients ask before choosing (mean 3.2).
The median overall score is 77 out of 100 (mean 77).
The least-answered questions are "What will it cost me?" (13%), "Can I book a first call without phoning?" (15%) and "How do I send my documents safely?" (23%).
The best-answered are "What do you do?" (80%) and "Where are you, and how do I reach you?" (46%).
Bookkeeping firms have the highest median score (79), against 77 for small cpa firms, 77 for advisory and fractional cfo and 75 for tax preparers and enrolled agents.
95% fail "Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone" (Core Web Vitals · LCP).
Bookkeeping firms show a price more often than CPA firms.
Kinds of practice differ in median score by at least 3 points.

technical.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone

agencyProblems.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone
agencyProblems.fix: Resize and compress the hero image, defer scripts, aim for under 2.5 s on a phone.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your home page takes several seconds to appear on a client's phone.

agencyProblems.label: A price, package or fee shown
agencyProblems.question: What will it cost me?
agencyProblems.fix: Publish starting prices or monthly packages for the common work: a personal return, a business return, monthly bookkeeping.
agencyProblems.pitch: The first thing a new client wants to know is what it will cost, and your site makes them call to ask.

agencyProblems.label: Book a consultation online
agencyProblems.question: Can I book a first call without phoning?
agencyProblems.fix: Embed an online scheduler for a first consultation, linked from the home and contact pages.
agencyProblems.pitch: A prospect who finds you at 10 pm cannot book a first call without phoning in the morning.

agencyProblems.label: AccountingService structured data
agencyProblems.fix: Add AccountingService structured data with the practice's name, address, phone and services.
agencyProblems.pitch: Search engines and AI assistants have to guess what your practice does and where it is.

agencyProblems.label: Text contrast passes 4.5:1
agencyProblems.fix: Raise text contrast to at least 4.5:1 in the theme.
agencyProblems.pitch: Parts of the site are hard to read, especially for older clients, and it is a WCAG failure.
